summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests abexinostat (PCI-24781) together with metronomic temozolomide in adults with recurrent high grade glioma. Abexinostat is taken by mouth on days 1-4, 8-11 and 15-18 of each 28-day cycle, and temozolomide is taken by mouth until disease progression or intolerance, with the record listing its dose as both once and twice daily. The study will determine the recommended dose and the side effects of this combination.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa abexinostat (PCI-24781) junto con temozolomida metronómica en adultos con glioma recurrente de alto grado. El abexinostat se toma por vía oral los días 1-4, 8-11 y 15-18 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la temozolomida se toma por vía oral hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o la intolerancia, aunque el registro indica su dosis tanto una vez como dos veces al día. El estudio determinará la dosis recomendada y los efectos secundarios de esta combinación.
who_for: Adults 19 years or older with high grade glioma (grade III or IV)
Prior radiation and standard temozolomide; further treatment for earlier progression is allowed
At least 3 months after the end of chemoradiotherapy, or biopsy or imaging showing progression
Adequate blood counts, kidney function and liver function
not_for: Another active cancer, except nonmelanoma skin cancer or controlled prostate cancer
Significant heart disease, certain heart rhythm problems, or prolonged QTc on ECG
Malabsorption or bowel conditions that affect drug absorption, or recent chemotherapy, radiation, immunotherapy or corticosteroids
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or uncontrolled systemic infection
Pregnant or breast-feeding, or use of valproic acid or another HDAC inhibitor
